description:
Search published fact-checks from organizations like PolitiFact, Snopes, AFP, Reuters, and Full Fact.

Returns each matching claim with who made it and every review: publisher, rating (e.g. 'False',
'Misleading'), headline, URL, and date. Start here when checking a claim that has circulated publicly.

claim.description: The claim or topic to look up, e.g. 'drinking coffee stunts growth'.
claim.title: Claim

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code such as 'en' or 'es'. Null for any language.
language.title: Language

max_age_days.description: Only fact-checks published in the last N days.
max_age_days.title: Max Age Days

publisher_site.description: Only reviews from one fact-checker, e.g. 'politifact.com' or 'snopes.com'.
publisher_site.title: Publisher Site

name: find_fact_checks
title: Find published fact-checks
